يزدرعوا (form VIII)
# يَزْدَرِعُوا (yazdariʕū) /jaz.da.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# يُزْدَرَعُوا (yuzdaraʕū) /juz.da.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
